name: mcp-trino-python
description: Query Trino and inspect or maintain Iceberg tables
long_description: Browse Trino catalogs, schemas and tables, run SQL, and inspect or maintain Iceberg tables (snapshots, manifests, partitions, files). Supports a read-only mode.

trino_password.title: Trino password
trino_password.description: Optional; enables basic auth (use with https)

trino_read_only.title: Read-only
trino_read_only.description: Allow only read statements and hide maintenance tools

tools.name: show_catalogs
tools.description: List all available catalogs.

tools.name: show_schemas
tools.description: List all schemas in a catalog.

tools.name: show_tables
tools.description: List all tables in a schema.

tools.name: describe_table
tools.description: Describe a table's columns and types (JSON).

tools.name: show_create_table
tools.description: Show the CREATE TABLE statement for a table.

tools.name: show_create_view
tools.description: Show the CREATE VIEW statement for a view.

tools.name: show_stats
tools.description: Show column statistics for a table (JSON).

tools.name: show_catalog_tree
tools.description: Show a hierarchical tree of all catalogs, schemas and tables. Can be slow on large installations.

tools.name: show_query_history
tools.description: Show recently executed queries from system.runtime.queries, newest first (JSON).

tools.name: execute_query
tools.description: Execute a SQL statement and return the rows as JSON.

tools.name: optimize
tools.description: Compact small data files of an Iceberg table.

tools.name: optimize_manifests
tools.description: Rewrite and compact the manifest files of an Iceberg table.

tools.name: expire_snapshots
tools.description: Remove Iceberg snapshots older than the retention threshold.

tools.name: show_table_properties
tools.description: Show Iceberg table properties (JSON).

tools.name: show_table_history
tools.description: Show Iceberg table history (JSON).

tools.name: show_metadata_log_entries
tools.description: Show Iceberg metadata log entries (JSON).

tools.name: show_snapshots
tools.description: Show Iceberg table snapshots (JSON).

tools.name: show_manifests
tools.description: Show Iceberg manifest files (JSON).

tools.name: show_partitions
tools.description: Show Iceberg table partitions (JSON).

tools.name: show_files
tools.description: Show Iceberg data files in the current snapshot (JSON).

tools.name: show_entries
tools.description: Show Iceberg manifest entries (JSON).

tools.name: show_refs
tools.description: Show Iceberg table references, i.e. branches and tags (JSON).
